commit_message:
[Bazel] Fix flatcc and bitcode library include paths when IREE is an external repo (#25101)

The fixed paths ("-I runtime/src", "-I .", fixed llvm-project header
paths) just work if IREE is the main bazel module. For IREE as a
dependency embedded in another bazel module, the paths need to be
prefixed with "external/" + repo-name with repo-name being the canonical
repo-name used by the main bazel module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code

---------

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: samples

commit_message:
[Runtime][VM] connect ISA decoder validation macros and tighten register verification (#25088)

Tightens bytecode verification in
`runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/verifier.c` and `dispatch_util.h`:

- Route `IREE_VM_ISA_VALIDATE_REG_I32` in `dispatch_util.h` through
`IREE_VM_ISA_VERIFY_REG_I32(ordinal)` and check `ordinal <
verify_state->i32_register_count` instead of compiling to `((void)0)`,
and clamp `type_id` in `iree_vm_map_type` when `module->type_count ==
0`.
- Check register ordinals against the declared
`function_descriptor->i32_register_count` and `ref_register_count`
(matching the frame size allocated in `dispatch.c`) rather than rounding
counts up to a power of two during verification, and reject
`ref_register_count > IREE_VM_ISA_REF_REGISTER_MASK`.
- Reject cross-bank (`i32` vs `ref`) register pairs in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_remap_branch_operands`, decode
`DiscardRefs` with `VARIADIC_OPERANDS_REF`, and reject trailing `cconv`
signature characters past `reg_list->size` in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_cconv_registers`.
- Initialize function state in `assembler/parser.c` before parsing
function argument and result register lists so `ireec` counts unused
argument registers in function descriptors.
- Add unit tests in `runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/module_test.cc`
covering each verifier check.

commit_message:
[Bazel] Fix flatcc and bitcode library include paths when IREE is an external repo (#25101)

The fixed paths ("-I runtime/src", "-I .", fixed llvm-project header
paths) just work if IREE is the main bazel module. For IREE as a
dependency embedded in another bazel module, the paths need to be
prefixed with "external/" + repo-name with repo-name being the canonical
repo-name used by the main bazel module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code

The bazel build used to support android only via a dedicated "--define=iree_is_android=true" option in the bazel command line. This change adds support for detecting Android also via setting a platform with "@platforms//os:android".

commit_message:
[Bazel] Fix flatcc and bitcode library include paths when IREE is an external repo (#25101)

The fixed paths ("-I runtime/src", "-I .", fixed llvm-project header
paths) just work if IREE is the main bazel module. For IREE as a
dependency embedded in another bazel module, the paths need to be
prefixed with "external/" + repo-name with repo-name being the canonical
repo-name used by the main bazel module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code

---------

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: linux_x64_gcc

input conversion, reusing the PT2E conversion.

commit_message:
[Torch] Convert torchao affine quantization to LinalgExt

Converts the typed torchao `quantize_affine` / `dequantize_affine` ops
to `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` / `dequantize_affine` during Torch
input conversion, reusing the PT2E conversion. A non-constant
`block_size` entry spans its dimension.

Ops LinalgExt cannot express (float zero points, non-constant or
non-integral bounds, fp8 storage, blocks that split a dynamic
dimension) stay on the existing Torch-to-Linalg path, as do PT2E ops
with float zero points now. Well-formedness of the Torch ops is left to
their verifiers.

LinalgExt divides by the scale in the scale type, where torchao
multiplies by `1 / scale` in the wider of the scale and real types, so
results can differ slightly.

Depends on llvm/torch-mlir#4843 and a torch-mlir integrate.

Part of #24862.

Signed-off-by: Roberto Laudani <laudani@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

commit_message:
[Torch] Convert torchao affine quantization to LinalgExt

Extends `ConvertTorchQuantizationToLinalgExt` to
`torchao.quantize_affine` and `torchao.dequantize_affine`, using their
`block_size` as the block size of the PT2E operand checks and builders.
A non-constant `block_size` entry, which `torch.export` gives for
per-tensor blocks of dynamic dimensions, spans its dimension and is
checked at runtime, as in the Torch-to-Linalg lowering.

Besides the cases the PT2E ops decline, torchao ops with scales
narrower than the real values, non-integral bounds, or blocks that
split a dynamic dimension are left for the Torch-to-Linalg lowering.
Ops with non-constant bounds, float8 storage, or scales and zero points
laid out unlike the blocks are not converted either; Torch-to-Linalg
does not support them.

PT2E and torchao ops with float zero points are left for the
Torch-to-Linalg lowering too. PT2E ones used to produce an
`iree_linalg_ext` op that failed verification.

Depends on llvm/torch-mlir#4843 and a torch-mlir integrate.

Part of #24862.

`block_size` as the block size of the PT2E operand checks and builders.

checked at runtime, as in the Torch-to-Linalg lowering.

commit_message:
[Runtime][VM] connect ISA decoder validation macros and tighten register verification (#25088)

Tightens bytecode verification in
`runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/verifier.c` and `dispatch_util.h`:

- Route `IREE_VM_ISA_VALIDATE_REG_I32` in `dispatch_util.h` through
`IREE_VM_ISA_VERIFY_REG_I32(ordinal)` and check `ordinal <
verify_state->i32_register_count` instead of compiling to `((void)0)`,
and clamp `type_id` in `iree_vm_map_type` when `module->type_count ==
0`.
- Check register ordinals against the declared
`function_descriptor->i32_register_count` and `ref_register_count`
(matching the frame size allocated in `dispatch.c`) rather than rounding
counts up to a power of two during verification, and reject
`ref_register_count > IREE_VM_ISA_REF_REGISTER_MASK`.
- Reject cross-bank (`i32` vs `ref`) register pairs in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_remap_branch_operands`, decode
`DiscardRefs` with `VARIADIC_OPERANDS_REF`, and reject trailing `cconv`
signature characters past `reg_list->size` in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_cconv_registers`.
- Initialize function state in `assembler/parser.c` before parsing
function argument and result register lists so `ireec` counts unused
argument registers in function descriptors.
- Add unit tests in `runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/module_test.cc`
covering each verifier check.

commit_message:
[CodeGen] Retarget executable lookups as their export refs are replaced

Linking an executable whose variants belong to several backends moves
only the variants of the linked target. The lookups of the moved exports
were fixed up afterwards from the executable that stayed behind: its root
references were enumerated with a module walk per executable and each
lookup was inspected to find where its functions had gone, which also
subjected lookups the linker never touched to those checks.

Retarget each lookup instead at the point where the export ref of its
function lookup is replaced, in the walk that already rewrites the refs.
The lookup follows what was moved rather than being reconstructed from
what remained, so no ordering dependency on the ref replacement and no
per-executable walks are needed. Root references that cannot be
attributed to a moved export are still rejected, and a module whose
symbol uses cannot be enumerated is now an error instead of silently
keeping references to erased executables.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Tobias Fuchs <fuchs@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[CodeGen] Retarget executable lookups as their export refs are replaced

Linking an executable whose variants belong to several backends moves
only the variants of the linked target. The lookups of the moved exports
were fixed up afterwards from the executable that stayed behind: its root
references were enumerated with a module walk per executable and each
lookup was inspected to find where its functions had gone, which also
subjected lookups the linker never touched to those checks.

Retarget each lookup instead at the point where the export ref of its
function lookup is replaced, in the walk that already rewrites the refs.
The lookup follows what was moved rather than being reconstructed from
what remained, so no ordering dependency on the ref replacement and no
per-executable walks are needed. Root references that cannot be
attributed to a moved export are still rejected, and a module whose
symbol uses cannot be enumerated is now an error instead of silently
keeping references to erased executables.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
[CodeGen] Retarget executable lookups as their export refs are replaced

Linking an executable whose variants belong to several backends moves
only the variants of the linked target. The lookups of the moved exports
were fixed up afterwards from the executable that stayed behind: its root
references were enumerated with a module walk per executable and each
lookup was inspected to find where its functions had gone, which also
subjected lookups the linker never touched to those checks.

per-executable walks are needed. Root references that cannot be
attributed to a moved export are still rejected, and a module whose

commit_message:
[Runtime][VM] connect ISA decoder validation macros and tighten register verification (#25088)

Tightens bytecode verification in
`runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/verifier.c` and `dispatch_util.h`:

- Route `IREE_VM_ISA_VALIDATE_REG_I32` in `dispatch_util.h` through
`IREE_VM_ISA_VERIFY_REG_I32(ordinal)` and check `ordinal <
verify_state->i32_register_count` instead of compiling to `((void)0)`,
and clamp `type_id` in `iree_vm_map_type` when `module->type_count ==
0`.
- Check register ordinals against the declared
`function_descriptor->i32_register_count` and `ref_register_count`
(matching the frame size allocated in `dispatch.c`) rather than rounding
counts up to a power of two during verification, and reject
`ref_register_count > IREE_VM_ISA_REF_REGISTER_MASK`.
- Reject cross-bank (`i32` vs `ref`) register pairs in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_remap_branch_operands`, decode
`DiscardRefs` with `VARIADIC_OPERANDS_REF`, and reject trailing `cconv`
signature characters past `reg_list->size` in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_cconv_registers`.
- Initialize function state in `assembler/parser.c` before parsing
function argument and result register lists so `ireec` counts unused
argument registers in function descriptors.
- Add unit tests in `runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/module_test.cc`
covering each verifier check.

commit_message:
[Bazel] Fix flatcc and bitcode library include paths when IREE is an external repo (#25101)

The fixed paths ("-I runtime/src", "-I .", fixed llvm-project header
paths) just work if IREE is the main bazel module. For IREE as a
dependency embedded in another bazel module, the paths need to be
prefixed with "external/" + repo-name with repo-name being the canonical
repo-name used by the main bazel module.

commit_message:
[Runtime][VM] connect ISA decoder validation macros and tighten register verification (#25088)

Tightens bytecode verification in
`runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/verifier.c` and `dispatch_util.h`:

- Route `IREE_VM_ISA_VALIDATE_REG_I32` in `dispatch_util.h` through
`IREE_VM_ISA_VERIFY_REG_I32(ordinal)` and check `ordinal <
verify_state->i32_register_count` instead of compiling to `((void)0)`,
and clamp `type_id` in `iree_vm_map_type` when `module->type_count ==
0`.
- Check register ordinals against the declared
`function_descriptor->i32_register_count` and `ref_register_count`
(matching the frame size allocated in `dispatch.c`) rather than rounding
counts up to a power of two during verification, and reject
`ref_register_count > IREE_VM_ISA_REF_REGISTER_MASK`.
- Reject cross-bank (`i32` vs `ref`) register pairs in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_remap_branch_operands`, decode
`DiscardRefs` with `VARIADIC_OPERANDS_REF`, and reject trailing `cconv`
signature characters past `reg_list->size` in
`iree_vm_bytecode_function_verify_cconv_registers`.
- Initialize function state in `assembler/parser.c` before parsing
function argument and result register lists so `ireec` counts unused
argument registers in function descriptors.
- Add unit tests in `runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/module_test.cc`
covering each verifier check.
